samples.text: Remote work opportunity! No experience needed, earn $900 a day, but only if you reply now and send a $75 onboarding fee.
We will mail you a check for office supplies. Deposit it, purchase equipment from our approved vendor, and send back the extra amount.
Your application for the bookstore stock assistant role is in review. We will contact you from our school district email address if the hiring manager wants an interview.
We can offer you a remote data entry position. Please send a photo of your identity document and tax number to prepare your file before we share the contract.
To get started as a home-based customer service representative, purchase the required training materials from this vendor. The course fee is reimbursed after your first month.
Your remote job is approved. Buy two gift cards for the home office and send us the codes so we can activate payroll.
Our cafe is hiring a weekend cashier. The duties, location, and $17 per hour range are in the public listing. Apply through the company careers page; no payment is required.
The community center has a weekend recreation assistant opening. Please use its public careers page to review the duties, pay, and contact details.
The bookstore is interviewing for a seasonal sales associate. The schedule, pay range, and duties are listed on its careers site; interviews are at the store.
Our hiring team needs you to receive a package at home and reship it to another address. We will reimburse postage after each shipment.
Earn $400 per day stuffing envelopes from home. Send a $40 registration payment now to reserve your kit.
Congratulations, you are selected without an interview. Pay a refundable background-check deposit by wire transfer today to begin earning $500 daily.
The school is looking for a part-time science lab assistant. The role, supervisor, work hours, and pay range are published on the school district jobs page.
Thanks for applying to the library page role. Please choose an interview slot from our careers portal. The hourly pay range and duties are listed in the posting; there is no fee to apply.
The city parks department received your application for seasonal grounds crew. Please review the interview details and hourly wage on the official city jobs page.
We are hiring remote assistants today. Deposit $60 in the next 24 hours to secure your position and earn up to $300 per day. Reply now for onboarding.
Your application for the library assistant role was received. The hiring team will review it and email you about the next interview step.
We have a job for you. Forward incoming customer payments from your personal account and keep 10 percent as your commission.
Thanks for asking about the restaurant host position. Please apply using the employer's careers page and contact the listed manager with questions. No purchase is needed.
As a remote order coordinator, you would receive client payments and forward them to our vendors. We provide a small commission for each transfer.
The remote assistant role includes a $35 refundable equipment processing charge. Let me know if you would like the payment instructions.
We would like to interview you for the museum guide opening. The position is 12 hours per week at $18 per hour, and the museum's public listing describes the duties.
Before your interview, please bring a copy of your resume. We can discuss the customer service role, schedule, and pay with the manager.
The role is ready to start. A one-time $25 account activation payment is part of the standard hiring paperwork.
The remote design internship pays $20 per hour. You can read the duties and interview process on the employer's website before deciding whether to apply.
The local clinic is hiring a part-time receptionist. Apply through the clinic website, where the duties, hourly range, work hours, and interview contact are listed.
This is a reminder of your scheduled interview for the part-time math tutor role at the school. The job description and $22 hourly pay are on the district website.
We will send a check for your laptop. Please purchase it from our supplier and return any remaining funds once it clears.
Would you be available to interview for the student recreation assistant role? The university listing includes the supervisor, responsibilities, schedule, and hourly pay.
For payroll setup before the interview, could you share your bank account and routing numbers? We will explain the role details after onboarding.
To get this work-from-home job, provide your bank login so we can verify your account before your first shift.
You applied for the summer coding instructor position. Could you meet the program director next Tuesday? The role, pay, and responsibilities are available on our school site.
